XalatathVoidAdept.name: Void Adept
XalatathVoidAdept.description: Quest: Detonate the Dark Heart on targets afflicted by Shadow Mark. Each successful detonation permanently increases Shadow Mark and the Dark Heart Ritual Detonation damage by 20, up to 10 times.

XalatathAnchoredCore.name: Anchored Core
XalatathAnchoredCore.description: Dark Heart Ritual: +25% Radius +25% Duration Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 damage.

XalatathCloakOfShadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
XalatathCloakOfShadows.description: Activating Void Step grants 50% Movement Speed and 25 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This bonus refreshes each time Xal'atath teleports.

XalatathFrozenMark.name: Cold Feet
XalatathFrozenMark.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark have their Movement Speed reduced by 25%.

XalatathDarkBarrier.name: Dark Barrier
XalatathDarkBarrier.description: Each time the Dark Heart damages an enemy Hero, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

XalatathVoidAcolyte.name: Void Acolyte
XalatathVoidAcolyte.description: Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley. The next Void Volley deals 25% increased damage and costs no Mana.

XalatathToxicMark.name: Toxic Mark
XalatathToxicMark.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration Heroes affliced with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by 10 and take damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health every second.

XalatathSilenceOfTheLamb.name: Silence of the Lamb
XalatathSilenceOfTheLamb.description: Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals 250 damage to enemies inside and Silences them for 2 seconds.

XalatathVoidSummoner.name: Void Summoner
XalatathVoidSummoner.description: Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xal'atath's original postion. Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark. XalatathHeroicAbilityVoidEruption.name: Void Eruption
XalatathHeroicAbilityVoidEruption.description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early. XalatathHeroicAbilityVoidConvergence.name: Void Convergence
XalatathHeroicAbilityVoidConvergence.description: After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies. You can have up to 1 active Void Portal. Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%. Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark. The Portal expi

XalatathPullOfTheDarkHeart.name: Pull of the Dark Heart
XalatathPullOfTheDarkHeart.description: Enemies damaged by the Dark Heart Ritual are Slowed by 10% for each pulse, stacking up to 5 times and decaying over 2 seconds.

XalatathDarkHeartsProtection.name: Dark Heart's Protection
XalatathDarkHeartsProtection.description: Detonating the Dark Heart now Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second. Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

XalatathCrushingCascade.name: Crushing Cascade
XalatathCrushingCascade.description: Enemies hit by Void Volley are Slowed by 6% for 2 seconds per projectile, up to 50%.

XalatathMarkedResilience.name: Marked Resilience
XalatathMarkedResilience.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark grant a 160 point Shield that rapidly decays. Shield starts decaying after 1 second, decays over 2 seconds.

XalatathPummelingStep.name: Relentless Whispers
XalatathPummelingStep.description: While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack Speed is increased by 150%.

XalatathFracturedReality.name: Fractured Reality
XalatathFracturedReality.description: +25% Void Volley Projectile Damage Void Volley's projectiles leave behind a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 damage to enemies. Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flames. Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds. Damage increases up to 300%. Damage

XalatathOrbitalEruption.name: Harbinger's Consumption
XalatathOrbitalEruption.description: Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.

XalatathRiftInvasion.name: Rift Invasion
XalatathRiftInvasion.description: Void Convergence's Void Portal self decay is no longer lethal, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.

XalatathDuelingOrbs.name: Dueling Orbs
XalatathDuelingOrbs.description: +1 Shadow Mark Charge Shadow Mark has a 3 second cooldown between uses.

XalatathUnstableCore.name: Unstable Core
XalatathUnstableCore.description: When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on a target afflicted by Shadow Mark, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for 5 seconds. Enemies in the flames take 45 damage over time. The flames deal damage every 1 second.

XalatathParadoxLoop.name: Paradox Loop
XalatathParadoxLoop.description: After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again. Bonus Basic Attack damage stacks up to 3 times
